messages:
alex_support: P1 -> Escalating to CS: onboarding blocked for 42 users on account PINE-211. Bulk CSV ingest failing with 504 gateway. Creating ticket S-8499. CC @nora_csm @kevin_ae.

ops_bot: [ALERT] gateway 504 surge (gateway-2)  linked to S-8499. 42 errors in last 15m.

nora_csm: Thanks Alex. Need short summary for AE and renewal owner. Set renewal risk to 'watch' for now.

alex_support: Quick impact summary: 42 invites stuck, 18 users attempted to onboard and saw "Something went wrong while activating your account". No data lost. CSV job id csv-211-20260321. Repro: upload same CSV via admin UI -> 504.

kevin_ae: Noted. I'll ping my contact and let them know CS is working on it. Please include ETA for workaround if possible.

reena_ops: Oncall here. Checking logs now. Hypothesis: gateway upstream timeout when backend takes >30s due to large file parsing. Can tweak timeout or recommend smaller chunking. Planning a hotfix: increase gateway timeout to 60s for ingestion route for next 10 minutes and monitor.

devon_se: If we increase timeout we risk slow requests tying up workers. Alternative quick mitigation: accept uploads but respond with "in progress" and process asynchronously. That's more infra work. For immediate relief we can support manual CSV splits and re-run.

alex_support: I'm starting manual split and re-upload for 20 users as temporary fix. Will update S-8499 with list.

nora_csm: Drafting customer note: "Hi <Name>, we're seeing intermittent failures while uploading bulk CSVs for invite flow. We're running a temporary mitigation (splitting large files and manual replays) to allow onboarding to continue. We'll follow up with a permanent timeline. Expect workaround ETA: 45m. - Nora, Customer Success" Approve to send?

kevin_ae: Approve. CC me. Also add that we'll waive first-month invoice if this materially blocks evaluation.

reena_ops: I've applied temporary timeout increase to ingestion route. Monitoring now; errors decreased in the last 5m.

ops_bot: [INFO] gateway 504s reduced to 6 in 10m after timeout tweak.

devon_se: We'll schedule the async ingest change next sprint. For now, recommend CS continue manual splits for affected accounts. Also posting a short runbook entry in the ticket: how to split CSVs and re-import via admin UI.

nora_csm: Sent comms to PINE-211 primary. Included workaround steps and ETA. Flagging renewal-status as 'watch' until resolved.

alex_support: Manual splits done for first 20 users (S-8499 updated). Remaining 22 queued.

ops_bot: [RESOLVE] ingestion route alert cleared - gateway 504s back to baseline.

reena_ops: Resolution notes: temporary timeout increased; root cause: parser blocking on certain malformed rows causing >30s processing time. Eng-runtime will add better validation and async processing.

nora_csm: Follow-up plan: 1) finish manual replays (alex) 2) eng-runtime RCE for parser edge cases (reena + devon) 3) update customer with permanent fix ETA (nora) 4) AE sync if >48h (kevin). Renewal watch active.

kevin_ae: Thanks all. Keep me looped on customer replies.

alex_support: Status 20/42 complete. Continuing.
